segments.text: Chairman Nava, to the honorable members

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: the opportunity to present to you

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Let me move onto the first slide.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: honored to appear before the House of Representatives as part of our accountability for the budget appropriated by Congress. In the next slides, we will present our annual budget utilization performance with some details on how we made good use of the allotments and then we will present the proposed budget for 2027.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: The DSWD's budget increased over the years and for this, we are thankful for the support of Congress. In turn, we made sure we put premium on the trust and the channeling our resources towards people-centered investments.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: First, human capital development. Reducing and ultimately ending poverty begins with investing in people's capabilities, particularly children, families, senior citizens, persons with disabilities, and other vulnerable sectors.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: We continue to innovate developmental interventions to improve the implementation of the different programs of the DSWD. Second, community-driven development. We continue to engage

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: the people in the farthest communities as partners in identifying needs, designing solutions and

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: building resiliency. And third, rapid, adequate and sustained disaster response. This is needed

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: to ensure that the gains in human capital development, particularly in communities of

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: vulnerable groups, are not reversed by the severity of disasters. The instruction of the

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: president is clear. The government should be there to respond immediately and remain present for as

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: long as families need support to recover. The next slides will show our report to Congress on

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: how we spent our budget. For our financial performance for fiscal year 2025, the DBM

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: released approximately $265 billion to the DSWD, both for our agency budget and releases from other

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: fund sources. We are pleased to report that the DSWD achieved a near 100% utilization rate as of

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: The DSWD has so far utilized 70% of the agency-specific budget of $262.9 billion. For the Calamity Fund and

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Quick Response Fund replenishments, 78% of the $9.6 billion released so far has already been utilized.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: The marching order to all DSWD programs is simple. Work harder, work faster and work smarter.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: We should not waste resources, and every peso

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: is a lifeline for beneficiaries in need. By directing our budget towards people centers investments,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: we bring our mandate to life, protect people in crises so that it would not become a long-term

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: setback, promote human development to improve people's capabilities and opportunities,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: abuse and exploitation of people in

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: transform people's lives by addressing structural barriers

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: that reproduce poverty and exclusion. So in DSWD, these four roles are interconnected

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: and social protection is the bridge, not the destination. The goal is not simply to help

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: people survive today, but government must work to give them a fairer chance to move forward.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: With this implementation track record as a backdrop, we now present the DSWD's

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Families Proposed Budget for Fiscal Year 2027. The proposed budget reflects our commitment to

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: building a bridge to self-sufficiency for every vulnerable client being served by the DSWD and

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: its attached and supervised agencies. It is designed to sustain critical social protection

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: and social welfare interventions while strengthening the systems through assistance

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: that is targeted, delivered, monitored, and evaluated. For Fiscal Year 2027,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: the DSWD has a total budget of $241.2 billion under the National Expenditure Program.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Of this amount, $235.7 billion is allocated to the DSWD Office of the Secretary.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: For attached agencies, the proposed budgets are as follows. $136.3 million for the Council of

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: the Welfare of Children, $91.6 million for the National Council on Disability Affairs,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: $126.3 million for the Juvenile Justice and Welfare Council,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: million for the National Authority for Child Care.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: For the supervised agencies, the proposed budgets are $3.8 billion for the National Commission on

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Senior Citizens, $359.9 million for the National Anti-Poverty Commission, and $233.4 million for

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: the Presidential Commission for the Urban Poor. Compared with Fiscal Year 2026,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: General Appropriations Act, the proposed budget under the Fiscal Year 2027 NEP for the DSWD includes

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: its attached and supervised agencies, reflects lower levels, with the exception of NACC and NCSC,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: whose budget increases are on their personnel services, because of the new positions created

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: and or filled up. It is also important to note that pursuant to Executive Order 123 issued on

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: August 18, 2026, the NAPC and the PCUP have been placed under the administrative supervision of

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: the Office of the President. Accordingly, while

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: their Fiscal Year 2027 budget figures are reflected in this

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: presentation, these two agencies are no longer under the administrative supervision of DSWD.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Looking at the budget by expenditure classification, the bulk of the budget remains

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: primarily directed towards delivery of programs and services to our beneficiaries. Generally,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: the operating budgets of all the offices for 2027 are lower than 2026. As mentioned,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: the increases pertain to the filling up of plantille position, which is very important for the

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: positions authorized by the DBM. Except for the DSWD, which was granted capital outlay for five

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: centers and residential care facilities in year three implementation of a learning institute in

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Davao and a warehouse in Iliilo, the DSWD has no capital outlay for 2027. We now proceed to the

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: major PAPs. We will provide you with their performance and accomplishments and report to

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: the members of this August subcommittee what we're doing to further improve service delivery.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: For the protective services for individuals and families in different circumstances,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: the bulk of the budget pertains to the assistance to individuals and families in crisis situation

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: or AICs. Although there are also community-based protective social welfare programs that we

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: implement to different vulnerable and marginalized sectors. For fiscal year 2025, we have already

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: utilized 100 percent of the budget which enabled the program to assist more than 9.4 million

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: beneficiaries for the year. For 2026, budget utilization is on track at almost 70 percent

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: of the allotment utilizing all its cash programming in real time, serving 4.24 million beneficiaries so

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: far. For fiscal year 2027, the proposed allocation is 33.3 billion consisting of 29.4 billion in

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: subsidies. Given the demand-driven nature of the program, the NEP amount may not be

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: enough to achieve the same level of performance for the past two years. We have informed our

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: budget sponsor about this matter and we have included also in our letter to the honorable

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: chair of the appropriations committee. Mr. Chair, in a bit, when we get into the discussions,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: we will show you a presentation that will show the adverse effect of this budget decline for the

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: assistance to individuals in crisis situation and the potential displacements of beneficiaries for

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: medical and other social welfare programs.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Your honors, it is given that AICS continues to fulfill its core mandate by providing a

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: comprehensive menu of assistance to individuals and families in crisis situations. But beyond

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: individual emergencies, AICS now serves as our primary tool for adaptive and shock responsive

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: social protection, allowing us to quickly act in cases of shocks which impact groups,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: families or communities at risk. In response to the national energy emergency declared

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: AICS is at the forefront and is in the front and center of the whole of government intervention under the Uplift program.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Through AICS, the government was able to put into motion interventions using three mechanisms under the adaptive and shock-responsive social protection.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: When the government needed to question impact of the Middle East crisis to our transport sector,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: the DSWD rolled out the cash relief assistance to drivers affected by the sudden increase in fuel prices as an emergency scheme.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Under this mechanism, we adopted a group-based assessment supported through identification, validation, and endorsement by relevant authorities or partner agencies.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: This assistance helped 1.839 million transport workers nationwide.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: A rapid assessment by the SWS Commission by the Australia Spring Programme

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: confirms that our cash relief assistance delivered immediate, decisive, impactful, and overwhelming

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: an overwhelming 96% of transport workers reporting that the 5,000 grant was operationally crucial in keeping them on the road,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: with 80% using the aid to cover essential household food expenses during the emergency.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Then the Uplift Committee chaired by the President decided to have a strategic pivot from individual-based to household-based assistance.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Through the Uplift under AICS, vertical expansion is implemented by top-up grants to help compensate for the diminished value of the

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: grants or subsidy being received by

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: existing beneficiaries of social protection programs. Through horizontal expansion, we extended financial assistance to households that were not previously covered by

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: existing programs but became vulnerable because of the shock. To accomplish this,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: we used the CBMS data to locate the poor, near-poor,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: and low-income and provide monthly assistance to them.

segments.text: As of today, we have provided

segments.text: karami yung nare-regularize. Hinahanda na rin yung second batch na 5,000.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Wow. Sige po. Dadako naman po ako sa ibang katanungan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Psychosocial support po. Ang DSWD ay merong program na tinatawag

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: na Wireless Mental Health and Psychosocial Support, or WeSupport. This

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: initiative aims to establish a systematic response in addressing mental

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: health and psychosocial concerns through wireless and online platforms.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Ilan po ang total users ng WeSupport platform sa nakaraang taon, at ano ang

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: breakdown per age group? Kung sakaling wala pong data right now,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: puwede naman pong i-submit sa committee. Kasama po doon yung isa sa katanungan ko rin na

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: ano-anong mga coverage ng WeSupport program

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Mr. Chair, the WeSupport program is a smaller program of the

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: department. 681 ang naging beneficiaries. Sounds really small, but we've already

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: pivoted under the Social Technology Bureau, a new program patterned after our

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: cash-for-work tutoring program, yung Tara Basa. Ngayon meron ho kaming Tara Usap.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: It's a peer-to-peer support group in colleges and universities that we are

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: now piloting everywhere. Ang naging partner po namin doon is the

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Ateneo School of Psychology, as well as the UP School of Psychology, kung saan

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: we're establishing safe spaces in schools. It's like Alcoholics Anonymous abroad.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: At kina-capacitate natin yung mga peer counselors, pero obviously klaro rin sa kanila yung hangganan ng kanilang kayang gawin and the referral pathways. So that's something that we're proud

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: of, that we're already innovating. We veered towards peer-to-peer kasi we

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: always believe in community approaches kung saan we

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: empower the community to take care of the community.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: May monitoring system po kayo para makita yung effectiveness sa pagbawas ng stress, anxiety, depression?

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Dahil pilot pa lang ho ito, bahagi naman ho 'yon ng design. But we

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: will gladly report back to the committee after the pilot run is over.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Para po sa huling katanungan, given the recent school shootings na nagpapakita

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: ng vulnerability sa ating mga kabataan, ano po ang kongkretong plano ng DSWD

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: para palakasin ang long-term psychosocial support ng WeSupport para sa mga kabataan?

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Madam, Mr. Chair, we're veering away not

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: just from WeSupport. Kami, we've been working with the Masayang Pamilyang

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: organisasyon, yung Masayang Pamilyang Pilipino organization

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: for the longest time. These are people from the academe,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: most notably si Professor Alampay, who is one of the more senior

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: academe members of the Ateneo School of Psychology. Kami naniniwala, patatagin natin yung pamilya.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: So we've revamped the 4Ps Family Development Sessions to strengthen

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: the role of our parents in making sure na alam nila ano yung mga red flags. Kasi it starts at home. Tama, malaki ang gampanin ng mga guro, pero pag kausap namin ang mga guro, nagsisimula yung formative years sa bahay.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: So that's why we're looking at it from a paradigm of a parent

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: or a family intervention. So una po 'yon, binago na ho natin yung 18 years na

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: curriculum ng FDS, ng Family Development Sessions, to

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: incorporate newer newer topics like digital uh

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: digital literacy but in the same case uh digital awareness or digital parenting

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: These are new modules. Number two, yung batas ho na Parent Effectiveness

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: and simula namin roll out and these this one is being done

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: together with edu child another known family oriented

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: local group that does capacity building for our parents. At the end of the day,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: yung long-term ho, we do the

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: sana huwag na maulit, but we do the post kung

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: may nangyayari. Working with the academe, we have trauma-informed care already na beyond

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Pero kami, ang approach pa rin namin, strengthening the Filipino families,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: strengthening our parents' capabilities so that they can watch over their children at home.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Just a short manifestation dahil wala na po akong time.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Mr. Chair, nais kong i-highlight na lang ang mental health support ay may direct

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: impact sa safety, learning at overall well-being ng kabataan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Kaya mahalaga na palakasin ang programang ito bilang preventive at

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: accessible support system para sa ating mga kabataan,

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: gaya ng WeSupport. Also, Mr. Chair, napansin ko po na bumaba po yung

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: pondo sa ating Supplemental Feeding Program na mula sa ₱9.56

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: bilyon nitong taon, naging ₱6.35 billion na lamang po sa NEP ng

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: 2027. At dahil po doon, in the proper time, I will move to increase the budget of the DSWD for fiscal year 2027.

segments.speaker: Rep. Dadah Kiram Ismula
segments.text: Hindi po dapat tinatapyas ang ahensya na inaasahan ng mga marginalized sectors at vulnerable constituents ng ating bansa.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
segments.text: May we call on Representative Adrian Amatong.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Thank you very much Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Magandang umaga po, Secretary Rex, sa buong DSWD family.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Mr. Chair, ang DSWD isa sa pinaka-active na agency sa distrito ko.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Alam ko marami siyang programs, pero dalawa sa pinakagusto namin, yung AICS at saka yung SLP.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Yung AICS dahil marami kaming mga mahihirap na estudyante na hirap na hirap silang mag-aral,

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: eh dahil sa flexibility ng AICS,

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Tapos yung sa SLP gustong gusto namin kasi iba siya doun sa mga doll out programs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: SLP kasi we give those who are willing to work really hard for themselves na mag-succeed

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: secretary gusto ko lang itanong. Narinig ko kasi medyo nabawasan yata yung budget niyo sa SLP.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: it's one of these line item na binanggit namin at sumulat rin kami sa committee

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: maibalik at least man lang, ma-augment by a billion pesos. Mr. Chair, that is correct. Congressman

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Amatong is correct. Yung SLP, we're very happy na maraming mga partners natin ang tinatanong

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: na SLP. That means nandoon na tayo sa mindset of teaching our people how to fish. We've actually

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: submitted a one-billion-peso fund augmentation sana for the supplemental, sorry, for

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: the Sustainable Livelihood Program. Kasi nga, that's part of our mandate, social development, hindi lang puro social welfare.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Mr. Chair, I'd like to support yung move na i-increase yung budget specifically

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: sa SLP kasi na-experience namin. Ako kasi minsan ngayon yung payout, ayokong pumunta sa mga

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: dole-outs kasi parang, although natutulungan naman yung local economy, pero

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: siyempre pagkatapos noon wala na eh. Pero yung SLP kasi ang laking promise, kasi nga sabi ni Secretary,

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: we teach our people how to fish. Hindi lang yung bibigyan ng isda.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Chair, gusto ko lang i-support yung move na yun na i-increase talaga yung budget,

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: kung pwede mas malaki pa sa one billion. Kasi dapat nandoon na tayo sa mode of

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: enabling our people na makatayo sa sarili nila. Kasi kung lagi na lang nating

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: binibigyan ng dole-outs, walang mangyayari. Lalaki nang lalaki yung utang natin dahil sa dole-outs natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Whereas ma-stimulate natin yung economy tapos mabigyan natin ng opportunity tumayo sa sarili nila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Malamang hindi na hihingi ng dole-outs, kasi yun ang goal namin. I really commend your team doon sa Zamboanga del Norte, sa third district, kasi kahit weekends, kahit holidays, nagtatrabaho sila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Kaya nagrereklamo din ako doon sa tinapyasan yung budget niyo for infrastructure,

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: kasi nakaikot na ako sa maraming opisina ng DSWD dito sa distrito ko. Kawawang-kawawa yung sitwasyon nila. Minsan isang kuwarto, siksikan sila parang sardinas. Pag kumilos

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: din yung iba sa dulo kasi nga siksikan na sila. Pati ang dami-daming

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: mga files na nandoon. So, Secretary, nag-request din kayo para sa augmentation sa infra niyo?

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: doon sa GASS na pondo na nawala rin. But I assure the good congressman, after

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: he raised the concern at nakita ko yung mga opisina sa kanilang lugar, that we've

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: already downloaded funds from the central office to repair those.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Admittedly, the regional director who is behind me again should have raised

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: the red flag and told us na wala na siyang MOOE so that we could have downloaded. But

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: we've addressed that concern. Pero in the long run, part ho iyan ng hinihingi

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: naming augmentation sa general services na budget namin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Mr. Chair, hindi lang ito sa distrito ko, kundi sa buong

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Pilipinas. Why? Because hirap naman nating i-expect na nakangiti, kailangan

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: nakangiti yung mga DSWD frontliners natin kasi nga

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: hinaharap nila marami ring problema eh. Pero napakahirap namang i-expect na nakangiti sila

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: kung pag umuulan eh iiwas-iwas sila sa tubig, tapos

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: kung napakainit and all. So para po matulungan naman ang mga taga-DSWD, mas

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: maraming kababayan natin. Siguro kasi nagrereklamo din yung mga kliyente niyo

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: pag pumupunta doon, minsan wala silang masilungan nang maayos. So,

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Mr. Chair, I'd like to reiterate the need to help DSWD sa infra nila.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Mr. Chairman, much appreciated. Pero let me just point out again.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Naka-embed sa mga budget, nakuwento ko nga ito kay Congressman, naka-embed sa mga

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: budget ng mga region namin yung repairs and maintenance ng kanilang mga tanggapan.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Hindi naman ho zero yan eh. That's why the regional director in Region 9 got a

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: tongue-lashing and will get more tongue-lashing after this, because hindi

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: niya ginawa. It's in the initiative also of the regional director. But we

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: do appreciate the additional fund augmentation, of course, pero hindi naman

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: ho dapat umabot sa ganoon. Admittedly, yung pinakita niyo sa aking mga

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: litrato ng mga satellite office sa inyong distrito, hindi ho dapat umabot sa ganoon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Pero Secretary, hindi yun yung intensyon ko. Intensyon ko ho naman po, support. Yes.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Tapos yun lang, Mr. Chair, yung number one concern ko lang talaga is SLP because nakita ko yung promise talaga nung

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: program. In fact, si Governor Uy ng Zamboanga del Norte also recognizes

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: SLP sa pagtulong lalo na sa mahihirap na mga probinsya. Alam ko yung sa mayayamang probinsya siguro hindi ganoon ka-significant yun.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: But for us, yung mga constituents natin na gusto nilang makahanap din ng paraan na makatayo sa sarili nila,

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: na medyo may pride din sila, na gusto nilang umasenso sa sarili nilang pawis, malaking-malaking bagay yung SLP po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Sana po yung pondo ng SLP ay madagdagan natin. Yun lang po.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Thank you again. I'd like to thank the good congressman for raising two very important things:

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: augmentation for SLP and augmentation for repairs and maintenance or MOOE namin.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Huwag ho kayong mag-alala, biro lang ho naman kanina yun.

segments.speaker: Rep. Adrian Michael A. Amatong
segments.text: Yun lang po. Hindi ko naubos yung time ko. Marami pang magtatanong. Maraming salamat po.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
segments.text: Thank you. The manifestation of Congressman Amatong is well noted.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
segments.text: We move on with Representative Sara Elago.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Maraming salamat, Mr. Chair, at magandang araw sa lahat.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: ang mga bagong programa tungkol sa Project SAFE,

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Nandiyan din ang enhanced na ProtecTEEN, hindi bago, pero mas napaunlad.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Nandyan din ang programa natin para sa children with disabilities.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Magkano ang pondo nito para sa susunod na taon?

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Mr. Chairman, right now, itong mga programa na ito are good programs na this year,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Nagkaroon ho ng tulong sa Kongreso at Senado na nakatanggap sila ng tig-25 million each.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Pero dahil sa NEP, inalis ho yun ulit, bumalik siya sa bare essentials na 50 million na paghahatian nilang tatlo.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Pero we also wrote the committee na baka puwede hong ibalik yung tig-25 million nila para mapalago natin itong mga programa na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mr. Chair, ano-ano yung maapektuhan ng mga activities kung hindi mapupondohan ito para sa susunod na taon?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ang proposal ng DSWD nasa 25 million level pa rin.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Obviously, Mr. Chair, we wanted more.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Pero naunawaan na rin namin na may tight fiscal space.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: So right now, hiningi na lang namin na sana mabalik lang sa 25 million kasi these are very good programs.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: For the ProtecTEEN program that takes care of our young mothers, to make sure that they don't give up on their dreams,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: and that their dignity is there,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: and that they can pursue and become productive.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: The total, the phase one of it is 415 young mothers for this year.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Ang maapektuhan siyempre kung hindi bumalik yan, yung 415 plus our projection sana na i-grow pa ito ng 841 nakaragdagang mga batang ina.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: And then sana sa year three, another 1,128.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: So all these numbers will not happen if we don't get back the funding that we had.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Now for Project Aruga, ito naman yung tulong natin sa mga pamilya na may mga anak na espesyal na pangangailangan,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: ang tinitingnan natin na maaaring maapektuhan ay 3,390 households.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: ito ho kasi, it's an advocacy program that protects us from OSAEC, or Online Sexual Abuse and Exploitation of Children, and trafficking.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Ang total na maapektuhan will be 3,417.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Mr. Chair, hindi dapat zero. Dapat ma-restore ang 25 million pesos.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Kung kaya pang dagdagan, dapat dagdagan para sa ProtecTEEN, Project SAFE at Project Aruga.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Ngayon naman, Mr. Chair, nabanggit kanina yung tungkol sa Haven for Women and Children.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Yung binanggit nyo po ba kaninang mga bilang para yun sa Haven for Women and Children na?

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Women lang po ito. Women and children kasama.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Mr. Chair, magkasabay po, women and children.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: They're normally, yung mga binanggit po namin na numero 14 na DSWD Managed,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: and then 54 na private that we also watch over.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: May bilang po ba kayo nung bilang ng mga victim survivors clients?

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Mr. Chair, we'll furnish you a copy of the data being asked pag private at LGU ran.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: What we have yung sa DSWD, 5,833.

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: May na-identify ba kayo ng mga LGUs?

segments.speaker: Rep. Sarah Jane I. Elago
segments.text: Na kinakailangan pang magtayo ng mga bagong social welfare facility?

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Meron po, Mr. Chair, and we'll gladly furnish you.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Pero ang naging direction na ho namin is a PPP scheme.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: If you can do PPP for healthcare, you can do PPP for social welfare and social protection.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Kasi una po, para magtayo, we need land.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: And then pangalawa, may gestation period.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Ang construction time and all the permitting will take probably a year.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: So mas mabilis po sana na i-augment na lang natin ulit yung nawala naming pondo

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: na in-allow na kami mag-cost of care na lang.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Yung mga ina-credit na namin, bigyan na lang natin sila ng mga kliyente

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian

segments.text: So, is it safe to say, Mr.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: A hundred and one percent, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Mercedes K. Alvarez
segments.text: So, speaking about AICS, Mr. Chair, what will be the effect

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Mercedes K. Alvarez
segments.text: Mr. Chair, if we forego or reduce the budget for the protective services for individuals and families, Mr. Chair?

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: mr chairman displacement we have a slide that i've been wanting to show since this morning

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: If we can pull it out.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Mercedes K. Alvarez
segments.text: Because, Mr. Chair, I'd like to add so that Secretary can also include it in

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Mercedes K. Alvarez
segments.text: his explanation, because unlike AICS, there are several studies which were pointed out recently,

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Mercedes K. Alvarez
segments.text: earlier. There is a World Bank study, there is PIDS, but can you also cite if there is also

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Mercedes K. Alvarez
segments.text: a similar study as to the effect of AICS? Thank you, Mr. Chairman.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Number one, Mr. Chairman, the fear natin, this is a

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: tabular format. In 2025, the allotment was 44 billion, pero nakita niyo may other releases pa

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: from unprogrammed na 14 billion. We were augmented actually kasi kinapos tayo

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: because, tulad na sinabi ko, there are unforeseen events like volcano eruptions, RSSI, these type of things

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: na ginagamit namin ang 4Ps. Ah, sorry, ang AICS. So in that year alone, we were able to serve 9 million,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Mga may mukha, mga pangalan 'to. These are actual beneficiaries. In 2026, when Congress heeded our call last year,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: you gave us 63.4 billion, of which 70% has already been obligated and we're in the process

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: of using that. Ang naging target natin is 8.7 million Filipino individuals who are coming to us day in and day out

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: out in our numerous offices. Now if we stick to the NEP level of 33 billion,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: ang projected na service gap, meaning yung tatanggihan natin dahil wala na tayong pera,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: is 4,085,631. And these are not mere numbers; these are real people

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: in your congressional districts, in your cities, na sasabihin namin, pasensya na po, lumiit po kasi yung pondo. So we are pleading

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: with Congress and later on in the Senate na i-restore ho to 63 billion yung pondo. Now I think there's

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: a next slide. May next slide to?

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: I want to point out that when the energy emergency broke out this year,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: that nobody saw, this is also the funding allocation for the uplift assistance.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: The close to 2 million drivers nationwide,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: of the jeep, tricycle, TNVS, service delivery,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: all of those were received by 5,000 because we used the AICS.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: The AICS sort of serves as a standby fund for unforeseen events.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: If that wasn't there, if you didn't raise it to 66 billion, 63 billion last year,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: we would have been finished by the summer and we wouldn't have reached our allocation

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: for the crises that we are facing now.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: So again, let me just put on record that we are asking Congress,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: as well as the Senate later on,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: to reinstate the budget of AICS to its current levels of 63.4 billion pesos.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Mercedes K. Alvarez
segments.text: Mr. Chair, so to end, thank you very much once again to DSWD.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: For Congresswoman or more, 63 billion or more.

segments.speaker: Deputy Speaker Mercedes K. Alvarez
segments.text: We fully support that, Mr. Chair. Thank you.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
segments.text: Thank you, Kong Chia-Ding. Thank you, Secretary.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
segments.text: We now recognize Representative Bong Soon-Tai.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Siyempre sa, to the DSWD family.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: disaster has struck our country in numerous times.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Madaming, well, nabanggit ni Sec pag erap ng bulkan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Merong mga sunog na nagganap, merong mga typhoon, which we were hit.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: So kaya ako lang nabanggit to, una, nais kong magpasalamat sa DSWD, as we all know.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Government should be there when it's needed.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: On time and available at yung pagtulong.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Pagdating dun sa disaster, masasabi ko na talagang on time.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Nasaksihan ko yan nung nagkabagyo sa aking distrito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Ready naman yung food boxes ng DSWD.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Andon yung mga sleeping kits, tsaka yung ready to eat.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Na pagkain, which was readily available.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: I believe it was like that in the whole of Metro Manila

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: because andito yung warehouses ng DSWD.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Ang tanong ko lang, sa probinsya po kaya, I believe that would be a problem.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Yung logistics and warehouse, paano yung response ng DSWD sa mga ibang lugar naman?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Na hindi readily accessible itong mga warehouse at saka yung mga trucking requirements.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Mr. Chairman, that's a very good question.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Under this administration, binaguhu talaga yung paradigm on disaster response.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Hindi tayo naghahanda o nag-repack pag nandyan na yung sakuna.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Rather, for the first time in our country's history, we now operate close to 1,040 warehouses nationwide.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: And these are different sizes warehouse.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Merong nasa syudad that we call hubs.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Merong kami mid-size hubs rin na nasa mga secondary cities.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: And we have last mile warehouses.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: As far as northern Palawan, in fact, alam niyo ni Congresswoman Salvame, or the GIDA areas.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: And the second paradigm change is, tulad na sinabi ko, 365 days a year, we repack nationwide.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: We're building the third one now in Mindanao because of Congress's approval of a multi-year allocation for it.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: So meaning, the goods are being drawn from bigger packaging centers in the three island groups.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: So meaning, naka-omnipresent, naka-palat na huyan.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Nung sumali kami sa departamento nung 2022, before my time, Secretary Erwin was already building on it.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: After six months, we carried on his mission.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: In fact, nung kaming dalawa, ang dinatan natin dyan na national stockpile ng food packs ay nasa mga 200,000 lang.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: At the height, before this sunod-sunod na bagyo, we ran 5.2 million family food packs nationwide.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Not just in Metro Manila, but all over the country.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: So ganyan karami yung national stockpile.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: And for this month alone, we've already released 3.6 million food packs nationwide.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Kasi tulad nyo na sabi ko, may stockpile tayo.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Yet the remaining stockpile now still stands at 3.2.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Meaning, we're running our factories beyond its capacity na 22,000.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: We're reproducing, responding, and stockpiling all at the same time.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Okay. Thank you very much, Mr. Secretary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Well, kagaya ng sinabi ko, pagdating dyan talagang nararamdaman.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Now, the protective social welfare budget for the SWD was decreased from 131.6 billion in 2026.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: What component program was affected by this?

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Mr. Chairman, the biggest is the assistance to individuals in crisis situation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Kasi if you remember, I think it was noong 2025, we dinifund natin yung ACAP.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Pero inabsorbed ng AICS yung beneficiary ng ACAP.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: But have we fixed the problems noong pag-absorb ng AICS sa ACAP program?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: They identified na yung aid distribution, nagkakaroon tayo ng duplication.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: May mga beneficiaries, nakakuha na ng AICS, nakatanggap pa ulit ng ACAP.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Mr. Chairman, that has been addressed.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: We've already explained that fully to COA.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: And the fiscal targets naman, if you're going to talk about the fiscal targets,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: we've met the fiscal targets noong kinonsolidate lahat sa AICS for last year.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: As you pointed out, as the good congressman pointed out,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: So yun yung pinakamalaki na nawala this year.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Yung inintroduce na amendment ng congress, yun yung nawala rin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Okay, but what controls have we now placed?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Paano nagiging distribution ngayon natin ng AICS?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: So per region, I think you posted it, but on a per district level, sino yung nagiging beneficiary?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Who gets the biggest chunk of this AICS?

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Mr. Chairman, it's always followed the same principle.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: It's on a need base and assessed by the social worker.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: We get referrals every day from everywhere.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: And it's really up to the frontline social services, the social workers,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: to see if we were to say yes or no to a particular request.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: So would it be safe to say that ngayon mas regulated na natin, hindi na po magagaya?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: For example, as a matter of fact, doon po sa distrito ko, during the previous congress,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: ang AICS pinang babayad po sa, pinang pe-payout yan sa mga nagpupunta doon sa mga pre-election rally, campaign.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: In fact, naging leaflets pa nga po yan eh. Pre-filled up na yung form.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Nakalagay na lang yung pangalan ng beneficiary at yung date. Tapos binabahay-bahay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: So have we corrected that? Dahil yung AICS is a stopgap for individuals na talagang kailangan ng tulong.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: And it should not be used that way. Dahil kawawa naman yung mga taong kailangan talagang matulungan na nangangailangan ng tulong.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Mr. Chairman, we totally agree. And we have tightened the implementing guidelines.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: May mga anti-EPAL, may mga CLARO na you can't use it for your own interest or your political gains.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: It's now enshrined both in the GAAA and at the same time our guidelines.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: And we take these things seriously. Kakasuhan yung mga empleyado.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Meron rin hong ganung provision sa loob ng aming administrative codes in the department.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Okay. Mr. Chairsec, as pinakita kanina ni Congressman Tino yung graph,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: and I was listening to your answer and very happy to hear that ngayon ang ginagawa natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Because yung support for SLTs and developmental programs talagang napaka-importante.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Ang ayaw natin is masanay talaga yung mga tao sa dole-outs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: We want the aid coming from the government to really affect and help the families.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: While I understand talagang hindi naman pwedeng tanggalin because there are some immediate and emergency needs and assistance na kailangan ibigay at makuha ng mga tao.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: But slowly, we also have to integrate. Ngayon nawala na yung ACAP.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Sinama natin sa IX yung 4Ps. I'm talking about yung 4Ps. Sana mas mapalakas natin yung 4Ps.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Dahil yung 4Ps, ang beneficiaryo ng mga 4Ps, kailangan sumunod ka sa RA 11310.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: There are strict guidelines, components to this, regulations that has to be followed.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: And makikita mo may result because it's not really a dole-out for them.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: It encourages and incentivizes families who are benefitting.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: So sana ito mapalaki. As correctly pointed out, yung ating sustainable livelihood program, lumeit yung budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Pero gusto nga natin palakasin yung mga ganitong programa eh.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: So maybe we should put some of the, kung maglalagay ang Congress ng budget, baka dapat dito ilagay instead of additional IX na naman.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: I think it was pointed out.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Nung nagsimula yung IX program nung panahon ng pandemia, because during the lockout, yung mga extreme lockdowns natin, talaga kahit yung mga gusto magtrabaho, hindi makapagtrabaho.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: After a while, nung natapos yung pandemic, hindi nawala yung programa. In fact, mas lumaki pa ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: But ang ayaw natin sana mangyari is mapag-iwanan yung mga...

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: ...developmental programs which would really lift the family from poverty or help them in a way.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Tama ko kayo that we've been tightening the four-piece, strengthening it.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: In fact, the World Bank last study said nga that it's contributed directly to 2.2 reduction in poverty.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: That's a sign that our implementation has been tightened.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: But I also want to point out na...

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Ninabanggit ko ito kanina kay Congressman Tino.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Yesterday's PSA briefing was quite revealing.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Sabi nila na the contributors or the drivers to poverty reduction, one, reduce inflation pre-2026, but also the growth in household income.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: There were five main reasons to it.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: So nandun na huhulog yung mga SLP natin.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: From the small business corporation of DTI, the whole government of approach na DAR, DA, has countryside livelihood.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Lahat yun na pagsasama-sama to entrepreneurship output.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Third lamang, or isa sa pang lima, yung conditional cash transfer na local, which is four-piece.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: So meaning, and other transfers, meaning the targeting is working.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Nakakontribute siya pero hindi natin nga gusto yun.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: And the other two is foreign remittances and pension.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: So kung lima yan, sabay ho, nandun yung entrepreneurship and nandun yung cash transfer.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: And like I agree with you, na dapat we have to wean off the cash transfer gradually while strengthening entrepreneurship.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Okay. And lastly, yung tanong ko lang sa 4Peace. Sir, ilan yung current beneficiary natin ng 4Peace? Ilan yung bagong enrolled sa 4Peace programs? At ilan naman yung mga graduate na sa 4Peace programs?

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: For the record, nung nagsimula ho ang Marcos administration, 4.4 million ho yan. Laging 4.4. So nagtanong ho, since 2014. So since 2014 till 2022, ang napag-graduate lamang po ay 50,000.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: We're not saying na walang umangatang buhay doon, but they weren't taking the exit mechanism seriously. But under the Marcos Jr. administration, simula ni Sen. Erwin, ngayon naman tinuloy namin, talagang pinag-igtingin natin yung case management.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Para yung mga dapat lumabas, lumalabas na. So from 2022 till now, 1.7 million families have already exited. Now, ang natinahong sa database natin, from minus that number, is at around 3 million.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Of which, if we are to peg it at the current poverty incidence, dapat 3.5 million na lang sila. Hindi nababalik sa 4.4. So that means by October, we're going to enroll an additional 500,000.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Okay. So, as I mentioned earlier,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: Sec. Rec., maraming maraming salamat sa agaran at available na pagtulong doon sa mga calamity-stricken areas doon sa aking lugar. Ito, nasaksihan ko. I'm sure it also happens in other areas, but doon sa distrito ko, meron mga sunog na nangyari nito mga nakaraang buwan at syempre yung pagbabaha.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: And I was witness that this, the assistance, kagaya nga ng sleeping care,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jesus "Bong" C. Suntay
segments.text: yung mga food boxes were readily available at walang nahalong politika. Napunta sa tao yung tulong na kinakailangan nila. Maraming salamat.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
segments.text: Thank you. Thank you, Cong. Buktsutay.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
segments.text: Past 12, may we know the pleasure of the Secretary.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: We can keep on continuing, Mr. Chairman, if that is the wish of the Committee.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
segments.text: We'll do it over working lunch or what?

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Working lunch is fine, Mr. Chairman. I know there are a lot of members who want to...

segments.speaker: Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
segments.text: So if you need a break, Secretary...

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: I will call a break. We will respect whatever the decision of the Committee is.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
segments.text: We can have a short break, if you wish.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Mr. Chairman, again, if I wish, pwede naman tayo, we can go the distance.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
segments.text: So we'll just have a working lunch for today.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
segments.text: Before we proceed, may I recognize our other members?
