segments.text: We have Cong. Christine Sison Mian.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
segments.text: We have Deputy Minority Leader Grisel Lagman.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
segments.text: We now recognize Representative Mila Magsaysay.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: gusto kong marinig mismo sa inyo,

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: saan po ba dapat under ang NCSC?

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Sa Office of the President po ba?

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Kasi naguguluhan pong mga senior citizens.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: At palaging nagtatanong sa akin kung saan talaga under ang senior citizen, ang NCSC.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Mr. Chairman, masalimuot ho yung sagot.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: I'll try to make it as concise as possible.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: We will submit to the good committee to be furnished to the good congresswoman

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: yung legal query ng department sa OP.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Kung saan sinabi nila, so to speak, na status quo muna po.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Meaning we supervise them, but we should not,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: we should not directly meddle at this point in time because of the legislation passed.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Pero naka-footnote rin doon that the law on optimization has taken into effect

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: and meron na rin hong IRR ng optimization.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: So meaning nothing stops the department from submitting an optimization plan

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: up until na-approve yung optimization plan

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: tsaka lang namin makukuha yung full control and authority over NCSC.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: So for now, it's status quo na independent ho sila sa amin.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: They are merely coordinating with us.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: For programs and for budget purposes.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: For budget purposes, nakasama ho sila sa araw pero ng talakay,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: pero nakahiwalay ho naman silang line item.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Kasi sa batas po kasi, under ng Office of the President, ang NCSC.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: So coordination lang po sa DSWD.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: That's been very clear by the legal opinion.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: The opinion of the Office of the President when we did the query like yourself.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Yes po. Kasi sa sulat po kasi ni Executive Secretary Ralph Recto,

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: lateral relationship, parang coordination lang po ng programs and parties.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Correct. But if you look at that same letter, meron ho yung caveat on optimization.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: So lumabas na ho recently yung IRR ng optimization.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: So we did submit our optimization plan that will include NCSC.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Okay. Thank you. Thank you, Mr. Secretary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: And at least na-klaro po kung ano po ang ano ng NCSC.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: And number two po, marami po akong reklamong natanggap na sobrang bagal at tagal po

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: ng accreditation process ng mga home care at elderly facilities.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Ano po kaya ang nagiging problema?

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: I can tell you point blank that we've streamlined it already.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Kami na ho siguro may pinaka maikling timetable kapag ka kompleto at pumapasok.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Pumapasa. Minsan ho kasi nagre-reklamo pero I can show you if you can give us the names

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: na minsan hindi ho pumapasa and we have to be very careful.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Hindi ho pwedeng i-insist na gusto nila, gusto nila because kami naman ho ang madadali.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Kung may pinalusot kaming accreditation na hindi pumapasa sa standards prescribed by the department.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Alam niyo ho, Mr. Chairman, it used to take almost six months to one year

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: to get a SWADA accredited, registered license and accredited.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Kami, as fast as two months time.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: As long as you pass the standards.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Kaya lang minsan ho kasi they will insist na pasado sila but our recommendation is hindi sila pasado.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: So doon ho talaga tumatagal but we do provide technical assistance.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: If susundan naman nila yung mga recommendation namin, mapapabilis at makukuha nila yung kanilang accreditation.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: And digital rin ho ang aming application.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Streamlined, meaning when you register, sabay na ho ang license to operate.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: So two weeks, ay two months lang.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Hindi na humano-mano na dinadaanan sa office yung mga requirements.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Number three, Secretary, under our existing laws po, mayroon pong 1% budget allocation for senior citizens at PWDs

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: ang bawat ahensya ng National Government Agency.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Mayroon po bang monitoring mechanism ang DSWD kung paano po ito nagagamit?

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: We signed a joint memo circular with DBM on its implementation.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: And I believe it's DBM through the submissions ng mga ahensya na nagmumonitor ng 1% compliance.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: So, nagpapakinabangan naman po ng mga senior citizens.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: And number four po, napakarami pong mga reklamo hanggang ngayon

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: ang mga mahal nating senior citizens tungkol sa payout ng social payout.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Ano na po ba ang nangyari?

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Mr. Chair, yan yung kaninang pinaliliwanag ko kay Congressman Ordanez

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: na unfortunately, the most of the grievances is inclusion.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: So, minsan nahihirapan ho kami dahil nga una, kalahati lang naman ho ang funded nung mandate.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Ibig sabihin, sa dami ho na kailangan i-accommodate, kalahati lang ho lagi taon-taon ang naibibigay sa amin.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Pangalawa, siyempre ho minsan lack of information,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: nasa-strike off sila sa listahan dahil nga meron silang SSS, GSIS, or other types of pension

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: na hindi nila naunawaan na pag may ganun ka na kasi maliit lang naman, feeling nila entitled sila

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: and we personally agree, naaalis sila sa listahan.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: And third, yung problema nga ho sa CBMS tulad na nabanggit namin kanina,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: which we've remedied already because nga ngayon, meron ng on-demand purpose

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: meaning pag binigay sa amin ng LGN listahan, magka-query na lang kami, maaring wala ka sa CBMS

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: pero pag nasa birth registry ka at wala ka naman sa death registry at ikaw ay matanda na, kasama ka ho kagad.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Okay po, kasi yun nga po, yung mga nagbawas kayo, kasi dapat lang humagbawas kayo

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: kasi may mga nagpe-pension, may mga medyo mayaman na tumatanggap, no?

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Pero ano pong nangyari, ano pong ba ang gagawin natin dun sa mga nabawas?

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Hindi ho ba pwedeng doon din iibalik yung mga nabawas?

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Again, we have to be, we have to look at the age kasi yung bagong guidelines namin, age muna.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: I think you would agree na unahin natin yung pinakamatatanda.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: So yung mga na-free up na slot, hinahanap namin sa CBMS yung 90 pababa

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: and then inuunti-unti namin malagay sila sa listahan.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: So it's not geographic in short, it's age.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: So titignan namin yung CBMS at yung mga waitlist, unahin natin yung mga pinakamatatanda

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: and I think that's the most equitable.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: At this point in time, nakalahati lang yung funded nung mandate.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Siguro mas maganda na ho, siguro universal social pension.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Ang mga seniors, lahat na po sila tatanggap na po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: So, paano po ba karami ang ma-existing at operational senior citizens

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Paano po ang budget allocation determination ng mga DSW-run elderly facilities sa buong bansa?

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Matagal po na pong binabanggit, kailangan natin ng mas maraming mga residential homes

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: and facilities for senior citizens who are abandoned, homeless, and neglected.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Ano po ang naging hakbang na ninyo dito?

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: We have four nationwide and admittedly kulang po ito.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: And that's why we're asking for more budget.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Pero tulad din ang paliwanag ko kanina, we are now taking, based on last year's budget,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: we are now taking a PPP approach to it.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Meron na kaming cost of care provision.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Kung saan, kung meron namang private na pwede natin doon i-refer,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: DSWD ho magbabayad ng cost of care.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Kasi mas mabilis, mas effective yung pagtatayo ng gano'n.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: We're almost done with the guidelines.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: We're just waiting for the final go signal from the DBM.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Four for the nationally-run residential care facility.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Three for the LG-run residential care facility.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Kasi ang dami po tayong abandoned and homeless senior citizens.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: At nito pong mga nakaraang mga linggo, sunod-sunod po ang mga pagulan at pagbaha

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Nasusunod po ba sa distribution ng mga relief goods or family food packs

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: na priority ang mga senior citizens?

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Tila hindi po ito nangyayari, Secretary.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Parang hindi po talagang mahal ng DSWD ang mga senior citizens.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Mahal na mahal namin ang mga senior citizens, lalo na po kayo.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Mr. Chairman, we have to remember.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Sa batas sa Local Government Code, ang first responder po talaga ang mga local government units.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Ang ginagawa lamang ng DSWD is to augment kasi kulang ang kapasidad ng mga LGU.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: We're proud to say that this tong mga habagat, 3.6 million na family food packs ang lumabas in a span of four months.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Ibinabagsak po natin yun sa mga local government units for them to do the last mile distribution.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Dahil wala naman ho kaming sapat na tao to do that or know-how ng terrain.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Now, we constantly remind our local social welfare offices to prioritize vulnerable sectors.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Seniors, people with disability, indigenous people, pregnant and lactating women.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Pati sa camp management kung saan nagaganap ang pinakamarami na aktividad during an evacuation,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: kine-remind din ho namin sila sa protocols.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Kasi, we set the standards, they execute it, we regulate them.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Pero sa 3.6 million na sana all na ho yun.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: So, we would assume na dapat nabigyan ho ng mga local government units yung kanila mga senior.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: And alam ko mahal na mahal ng mga local government units ang kanila mga senior citizens.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Yes, because seniors are the most vulnerable sectors when it comes to calamity.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: So, for the record, Mr. Chair, I just want to put this in the record that I would like to...

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: to file a complaint against Region 1 Director Angela Gopela for her arrogance and her...

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: and doing injustice to the senior citizens.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Mr. Chairman, we will accept and we will commission the necessary fact-finding

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: and go through our administrative process and we will report back to the committee.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Thank you. She doesn't deserve that position.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
segments.text: Thank you. Thank you, Kuwang Mila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Chair. That's all.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Maybe, can we take up already the budget of the NCOC or later?

segments.speaker: Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
segments.text: Maybe later. I think it's already incorporated.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
segments.text: We now recognize Cong. Elijah San Fernando. Is he around? No. So, Representative Edgar Erice...

segments.speaker: Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
segments.text: Is he around? Representative Iris Montes.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Magandang tanghali po, Secretary Rex, and to the whole DSWD family. Most of my questions

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: have been previously asked and have been adequately answered by the secretary so i just have

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: one simple question but before um i i asked that um i was just requested by our colleague

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Congresswoman Johanne Monich Bautista to ask about her concern

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Tungkol po ito, Secretary, sa QRF.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Sa presentation po kasi mapapansin natin,

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: is 1.25 billion. Tapos nagkaroon po ng replenishment ng 7.8. Sa 2026, 3 billion po, nagkaroon ng replenishment na 9.6. Ang concern lang po ng ating colleague ay for 2027, 1.25 lang daw po. Hindi po ba daw kukulangin? Assured po daw tayo ba na kahit maliit ito ay magre-replenish ulit?

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Mr. Chairman, it's a very good question. Nagagalak ho kami sa tanong na 'yan. Actually, may assurance naman ho na may pondo kasi replenishable. Pero siyempre sa panahon ng sakuna dapat mabilis ho kami, maagap. So nakikiusap ho kami, sumulat rin kami sa committee na sana ma-restore back to its 3 billion level. At dati napagbigyan naman ho kami para mas mabilis kami na nakaka-responde, lalo na sabay-sabay ho yung sakuna. It's no longer contained in one area; it's multi-region.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: So sana ho mabalik ho talaga kami.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: We are earnestly asking the committee to consider because ho

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: maaapektuhan yung turnaround time namin sa pag-responde, pag-procure, paglatag ng emergency cash transfer.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: And I want to point out, para lang sa kaalaman ng lahat, wala namang dagdag na cost sa gobyerno dahil nandun lang siya nakalagak sa QRF ng national.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: So, sana lang lakihan yung seed capital ng QRF namin para mas mabilis kaming makaresponde.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Thank you, Secretary. This representation shares your sentiments and I do support that we restore your 2026 QRF levels.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Moving on to my question, a simple question, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: The DSWD has repeatedly faced challenges in ensuring timely and targeted delivery of social protection programs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Yan po ay nasabi nyo na, nabanggit nyo na during the lead committee hearings at kanina po, parang nire-iterate po ninyo uli.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Dahil po, meron tayong fragmented and disconnected data system.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: So, wala po tayong real-time na accurate na data.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: So, medyo nahihirapan po tayo to roll out sa part po ninyo yung mga social protection programs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: That is why this representation, ang kababaihan kabalikatan para sa kapakanan at kaunlaran ng bayan, actively participated during the lead committee hearings.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Out of that, the 4K has filed at least six or seven interventions, one of which is House Bill 9084.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: It calls for the establishment of a national and integrated registry system.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: That is interoperable to address this gap.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: So, the system establishes the foundational mechanism for efficient, transparent, and responsive governance.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: It also proposes a system that builds on existing national initiatives, such as the Philippine identification system and social registries, transforming them into a unified data ecosystem that supports inclusive growth and digital transformation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: So, it also addresses the long-standing fragmentation of government data systems, which limit efficiency and effectiveness of public service delivery.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: But beyond Mr. Secretary, a single registry, what the country truly needs is an integrated yet interoperable system that connects administrative registries like LGU household records, barangay level data,

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: data, sa civil registration and identification systems naman po, nakapaloob sana doon yung

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: PhilSys, birth and death records, and national ID.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Dapat meron din po sigurong component na sectoral and program-based registries.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Nandoon po yung 4Ps, yung senior citizen, yung PWDs, meron pong disaster response list,

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Sa social registry naman po, dapat meron mga poverty targeting mechanism,

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: household vulnerability mapping, meron din pong PhilHealth, GSIS, SSS, DepEd, DOLE, and LGU databases.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: So, only by linking the systems can we ensure real-time, accurate, and inclusive targeting of beneficiaries,

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: while also, kapaloob din po doon sa bill, pag-safeguard ng data privacy and accountability.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: So, ang simpleng tanong ko lamang po, Mr. Secretary, does the department view this integration as a step towards the right direction?

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: And will the Secretary support this reform?

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Mr. Chairman, in fact, we are doing a small pilot inside the department, a social registry that integrates our own databases

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: from 4Ps, Walang Gutong, the program databases.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: But it would be nice if it's scaled up to a national level.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Maraming salamat po, Mr. Secretary, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: I will furnish you po a copy of my bill.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: And I will appreciate if you can take a good look at it.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: And siguro po, you can share, you can review, send some comments and inputs to improve the bill.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: And if you find it helpful and necessary, perhaps I will just request the Secretary to bring it up, perhaps, to the Executive.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Department for its passage or for it to be a priority of this Congress.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Mr. Chair, we'll gladly accept that we already registered our full support to the bill in writing early on.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: So, we'll gladly accept and see if there are new angles that you want us to comment on.

segments.speaker: Rep. Iris Marie Demesa Montes
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Chair, that would be all.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: And magandang hapon po sa DSWD family, Secretary Rex Gatchalian.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: I believe my, one of my questions was asked earlier by Kong Iris.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: I akala ko po hindi ako makakabalik agad, but now I'm here.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: I just wanted to join my colleagues who already expressed their

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: And commendation to the DSWD family, of course, under the outstanding leadership of Secretary

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: Rex Gatchalian for their timely and effective delivery of social services.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: Kitang-kita po natin sa bawat sakuna, sa bawat trahedya po, nandyan po on the ground, always

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: at the forefront ang ating DSWD.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: Maraming salamat po sa inyong servisyo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: And with that, I express my full support para po sa budget ng DSWD.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: Marami pa pong mga kailangang idagdag.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: Nabanggit na po kanina, kagaya po nung AICS, hindi ko na po babanggitin kasi I believe

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: as Secrex was able to explain and justify the need to at least return the amount that

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: And then yung QRF din po na nabanggit ni Kong Iris Montes kanina, nakita naman po natin,

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: Kita naman din po natin na itong pondong po ito ay diretsyo naman po yan sa mga tao.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: So tayo po ay hindi po dapat magdalawang isip at maging panatag po tayo kung dadagdagan

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: po natin ang pondong ito na kailangan po ng DSWD.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: Siguro po just one more question, since natanong na po yung QRF kanina.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: On behalf lang po ng ating mga workers po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: Mr. Chair, kasi po siguro the good secretary can explain.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: Ang hinanaing po kasi ng iba po sa ating mga workers, sinasabi po nila na they feel like

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: minsan po na pag iiwanan sila pagdating sa mga social services po ng ating gobyerno.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: Dahil of course hindi ko naman po sinasabi na definitely priority po natin yung mga higit

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: But then we also have our minimum wage earners, even our middle class workers na isang emergency,

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: medical emergency lang, isang namatayan ay maapektuhan na po ang kanilang finances.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: So maybe the good secretary can explain or inform our minimum wage workers, yung pong

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: And entitled to the programs of the DSWD.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Mr. Chairman, I just want to again point out na ang AICS ho is for everybody.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: It looks at the crisis situation more than the income level.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: So lagi namin sinasabi magtungo lang ho sa aming mga tanggapan para ma-assess ng social

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: And in fact, I just don't have the data with me.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: We will gladly furnish the committee.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: A percentage, a real significant percentage of AIICS really goes to those above the middle

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: So those above the poverty threshold, the near poor.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: I just don't have the percentages right now but we'll send it to you.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: It goes to show na yung crisis in crisis situation yung tinitignan.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Now number two, the president also instructed us to widen the lalo na ngayong energy emergency.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: That's why the uplift assistance has three components to it of which yung pangatlo is

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: These are above minimum wage earners ng SSS.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Ang na-service na namin around 800,000 kasi tulad na nabanggit ko kanina dormant yung beneficiary

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: But we're working on that with SSS to try to look for more of them para ma-exhaust natin

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: yung 1.5 the monthly allocation na tigta 2,000 para sa ating mga SSS low wage earners.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: And thank you for that explanation po from our Secretary Rex Gatchalian.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: I think yun lang po ang aking ipo-point out.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: And again, I just wanted to manifest our sincere appreciation to the good Secretary and the

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: entire DSWD family for all their hard work 24-7.

segments.speaker: Rep. Johanne Monich G. Bautista
segments.text: Maraming salamat po and we manifest our strong support for the needed budget and the requested

segments.speaker: Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
segments.text: We now recognize Representative Krisel Lagman.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: Iba talaga pag rooted sa local government ang head ng department.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: Lalong-lalo na pagdating sa social services.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: Damang-dama po namin ang hands-on approach

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: and holistic approach ng inyong paggogobyerno, Secretary Rex.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: Maging bagyo man yan o mga volcanic eruptions.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: Itong nakaraan ang pinakamahaba na evacuation time sa loob ng evacuation centers.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: Nagsimula ng January 6 at nag-decamp ng August 6.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: And hindi po talaga nagpabaya ang DSWD.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: Naandito ang aming regional director, si RD Norman Laurio.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: And nagpapasalamat po ako sa agaran at maliksi na pag-responde niya sa mga pangailangan ng aming mga evacuees.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: In fact, every 15 days, may binibigay na good for 3 days na food packs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: So, sa isang buwan, nakaka-receive ng mga around 9 to 10 boxes ang aming mga families.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: Ito lang po ang aking comment.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: Ang ibig kong sabihin, maging isang miyembro lang ng pamilya,

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: eh ang ibinabahagi po ay isang kahon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: And every 3 days po sila nakaka-receive nito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: Baka maaari po na maging mas maayos ang pagbabahagi nito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: Kasi ang isang pamilya na may isang miyembro,

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: At makakareceive ng 6 kilos of rice every 3 days ay napakalaki po na appropriation na sana ay napunta doon sa mas malalaking pamilya.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: So, iyon po ang isang comment ko.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: Pangalawa rin naman po yung variety.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: Alam ko kakaiba ang sitwasyon namin sa Albay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: Hindi all the time ay ganito kahaba ang evacuation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: Ang iba ilang araw lang, baka linggo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: Pero nangyayari po at nangyayari pa lang.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: Kaya ang pakiusap ko po sana may variety rin ang laman ng mga boxes natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: And sana po naandito ang chairman ng Ways and Means Committee.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: And napansin po namin ay yung madali pong ma-distribute at matagal ang shelf life ang nilalagay natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: Subalit sana po instead of 3-in-1 coffee na loaded po talaga sa asukal at flavorings,

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: baka po po pwedeng stick na lang ng coffee.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: Baka mas marami pang mabibili kesa sa limang pakete ng 3-in-1.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: Baka po pwedeng isang dosena na ng stick ng coffee.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: Kasi at least yun totoong kape at hindi loaded sa asukal.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: Nakalagay rin po doon ay Ovaltine.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: And maganda po yun para sa mga bata.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: Pero sana magkaroon ng mas nutritious na substitute.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: Kasi ang tinitingnan lang po natin ay hindi lang yung may pantawid gutom,

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: kundi sana nutritious din po ang laman ng ating pinamimigay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: So wala po akong masyadong reklamo, sir.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: Masyado nga pong na-pamper yung mga LGUs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: Kasi under your watch, ngayon lang namin naramdaman

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: na hindi na iisipin ng LGUs kung ano ang ipamimigay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: Hindi lang siya quick response, pero sustained ang response.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: Tuloy, yung probinsya ng Albay, for instance,

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: At nung pag-decamp, doon nagbigay pa ng fresh food.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: Yung mga LGUs naman po ay hindi na gumagamit ng kanilang quick response funds.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: Kasi umasa na lahat sa DSWD.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: So kanina sinabi ninyo na kayo ang pang-augment.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: So palagay ko may mali rin po doon sa senaryo, sir.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: hindi ba po pwedeng i-ask sa lahat sa DSWD?

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: Lahat ako, salita, hindi ko malang narinig yung response ninyo.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Now is the time that we study our options on individuals versus family packs.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Mahirap sa logistics sa storekeeping, pero we're up to the challenge.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Hindi na lang ngayon kasi sa Albay nangyayari.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Ito yung protracted disasters, like what we're seeing now in Central Luzon na one month and a half na.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: When those boxes na, we just kept what it was nung na nakuha namin yung control ng department.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Tama ko kayo, we have to start thinking of the new type of disasters that's hitting us.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: And variety is something that's important.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: The food fatigue is something that's real.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: So we will take that into account.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: But the first two items, well noted, we will study.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: That means us storekeeping multiple types of packs.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: But we're up to the challenge.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Ako, I myself drink black and I agree.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Pero gusto ko lang ko i-point out, lahat ho yun, bago nalagay sa kahon, dumadaan sa FNRI.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: It passed their minimum standards, but we will review.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Well noted as well, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Mr. Chair, and last but not the least, yun sa QRF.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: And you said what I can't say publicly because we're in the middle of a disaster.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: But rest assured that we're already talking to DBM because we're seeing slow or low utilization ng mga quick response sa LGU level.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: And I would also point out nga na unlike the national QRF na na-exhaust sa lokal, you know this very well,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: nare-revert yan after two years or three years into the general fund.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Five years pala, sorry, five years.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: I haven't practiced local government in more than four years now.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: So we have to really think about what you said.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Kasi ang sinasabi nyo, lagi ko rin yan sinasabi na sa isip ko.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Pero we're going to find a way to make the LGUs counterpart man lang.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Kasi nga, like I said, mabigat na ng pabigat.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: And I hope we see lang kasi the only reason why we're doing this massive is because in a hungry family, walang national government, walang local government.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Pag galit siya sa gobyerno, galit siya sa gobyerno.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Kung hindi siya nakakuha ng pagkain, galit siya.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Pero it's no reason for the lopsided utilization of the QRF.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: While the national government is using its QRF massively to a point na nade-deplete natin,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: the local government will look at how they utilize and how to prod them with the help of DILG and DBM to spend their QRFs also.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: I would just like to add na maganda yung aksyon na ginawa ng DSWD

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: na nagbigay ng Emergency Cash Assistance para mabibili nila yung mga [unclear] items na kailangan rin nila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: Pero sa 7 buwan at isang Emergency Cash Assistance, baka sa susunod pa pwedeng planuhin na mas madalas.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: May cash for work. One cash for work, one emergency cash assistance.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: So baka mas tingnan natin kung pa paano mabalansihin.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: And since it's an ongoing disaster, si Mayon hasn't really de-escalated.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: The Undersecretary for Disaster will sit down with a good Congresswoman on packaging more.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: But well noted not just for Mayon but for every other protracted disaster.

segments.speaker: Rep. Cielo Krisel Lagman
segments.text: Maraming maraming salamat, Secretary. And congratulations, job well done.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
segments.text: As if we're running out of interpellators, Mr. Secretary.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
segments.text: The good thing is we have with us the Committee Chair of the Ways and Means.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Actually, I wasn't supposed to ask you a question, but it seems that for the first time we're running out of warm bodies.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: So just to keep the conversation going, well, I mean honestly, I have nothing to ask.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Because how do you fix something that's already working?

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: I think we have very hardworking employees.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: The response time has become so much quicker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Even in terms of professionalizing the distribution and pickup of our pag-asa boxes.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: How do we call our boxes again?

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: I said that earlier, in previous years, parang kahon ng pag-asa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Because it does. I mean, that's what it does.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Meaning when people see it, it's already a symbol of something that addresses deep wants at a very dire moment.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: So tingin ko, baka pag-isipan natin, it's too businesslike.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Parang it's part of a key performance indicator.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Parang ganun ang dating eh, di ba?

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: I think with something more, yeah, something more spiritual, di ba?

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: But anyway, so even the way that it's managed, the way they are packed, these are very simple things.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: But even on the part of the end user, you see them very much satisfied.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: And even the way it is packed today, I have rarely heard of anyone actually na, ang tawag dyan, binuburiki eh.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Yung dinidismantle and then nilalagay in their own political packaging.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Hindi ko na rin nababalitaan yan eh.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Tanggal pala yung scotch tape dyan, di ba?

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: yung tanong ko na lang is really on senior citizen pension.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: So, I've seen that while the budget for this, for next year, is actually lower, slightly lower from this year.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Despite the fact that the target has increased by, I think, more than 50,000, ang additional beneficiaries.

segments.speaker: Rep. Atty. Miro S. Quimbo
segments.text: Pero bakit mas mababa yung budget?

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: And even that, kasi kapos na kapos eh.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: We are fully supportive of the provision that you've been pushing together with former Congresswoman Stella

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: on a universal senior pension, social pension for senior citizens.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: It will address the public perception na pinipili.
