segments.text: Yung isang tanong na lang po,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: yung kaugnay naman sa Expanded Centenarians Act.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, upon reaching 80, 85, 90, 95 ng mga senior citizens,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: they are entitled to a cash gift of 10,000.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ang tanong po, ang concern ay, siyempre,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: baka hindi na mapakinabangan ng mga senior citizens natin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, ano po ang status ng implementation nito?

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: I would yield the floor to the NCSC representative

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: And in the letters na back and forth na binasa kanina ni Congresswoman Magsaysay,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: they made it very clear that we are only to coordinate with them

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: but not to interfere with their operations.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: So, I would leave the answering to somebody who is more competent on the matter,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: which is the NCSC Executive Director who is with us this afternoon.

segments.speaker: NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
segments.text: With the indulgence of our Secretary Rex, Rep. Tinio,

segments.speaker: NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
segments.text: regarding the implementation of the ECA,

segments.speaker: NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
segments.text: we have already served 179,000 senior citizens as of August.

segments.speaker: NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
segments.text: And we have already utilized almost 2 billion of our 3.4 million budget.

segments.speaker: NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
segments.text: 179,000 na po mahigit ang ating nasa-serve na senior citizens.

segments.speaker: NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Is it just for this year?

segments.speaker: NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
segments.text: Bale, ang target po for this year ay nasa 299,000 senior citizens.

segments.speaker: NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
segments.text: Of that po, yung mga applications na na-process and nabigyan na po natin ay

segments.speaker: NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
segments.text: Yung iba po, 100,000 kapag kapag nag-100 years old.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Gano'ng katagal po yung processing time?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Gano'ng katagal po, average processing time?

segments.speaker: NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
segments.text: Quarterly po kasi kami nagdi-distribute ng aming gift

segments.speaker: NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
segments.text: because of budgetary constraints in the distribution of the gifts.

segments.speaker: NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
segments.text: Ang budget po namin for this year...

segments.speaker: NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Yan po ba yung tansya nyo na lahat na maaring mag-qualify?

segments.speaker: NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So, sa tansya nyo, kayang ma...

segments.speaker: NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
segments.text: Sa tansya po namin, sa dami po ng applications,

segments.speaker: NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
segments.text: mukhang kukulangin po yung tansya namin na 299,000.

segments.speaker: NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
segments.text: As of now, nasa halos 200,000 eh.

segments.speaker: NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
segments.text: Ongoing pa po yung aming cash gift distribution hanggang sa ngayon.

segments.speaker: NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
segments.text: Nag-birthday, ngayon lang po nag-a-apply yung iba.

segments.speaker: NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Gano'ng katagal o kabilis po ang processing time nyo?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Yan po ang concern ng mga lumapit sa amin na

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: nag-aalala sila na masyadong matagal yung processing time.

segments.speaker: NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
segments.text: Opo, kasi every 3 months lang po kami nakaka-apply.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Kano po ang proposal for next year?

segments.speaker: NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
segments.text: For next year po, ang proposal namin ay nasa 303,000 na higit na senior citizens.

segments.speaker: NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
segments.text: And ang budget po ay nasa 3.8 billion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Sa tingin nyo, sapat ang budget na yan?

segments.speaker: NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
segments.text: Makakarequest naman po kami sakali pong lumampas po sa 303,000

segments.speaker: NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Ah, sa DBM. You mean for augmentation from savings?

segments.speaker: NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: May iba pa bang source ang DBM?

segments.speaker: NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
segments.text: Kasi po, pag nag-apply, saka lang po kami makakahingi ng augmentation sa budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Chair. Yun na lang po ang tanong natin.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Mr. Chairman, if I can just add for the information of Rep. Tinio.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: At nung iniwan po namin yung programa, we have highly encouraged ang NCSC to work with PSA.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Kasi remember, may CDMS naman po na po-forecast natin in advance.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: It doesn't have to be a by-application process.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Kasi I think, yung concern ho niyo, Congressman, doon na nga nga na ko,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Kasi minsan, mali yung, hindi pa mali, but mali yung projection.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: But it's not a rocket science po.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: The CDMS actually points us to the way.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: We're now tallying it nga kasi may kopya ho kami niyan dahil nga sa social pension,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: But we can submit it to you and we will continue to encourage the NCSC to look at the paradigm

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: na i-forecast na lang natin in advance para tama po yung mahingi na pera sa DBM

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: at tayo na ho ang lalapit sa kanila kesa sila ang lalapit sa atin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Thank you po and we would appreciate yung may sasubmit na information ni Secretary Rex, Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: So please po, pakibigay lang po. Thank you.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio L. Tinio
segments.text: Yun na lang po, Chair. Maraming salamat.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
segments.text: We now recognize Congressman Tonypet Albano.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: Unang-una, ako'y proud na proud sa aking kaibigan na si Secretary Rex Cachalian.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: Sana katulad ko makahanap ka ng kabyak sa puso.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: Yun din ang aking mensahe kay Senator, Senate President na kapatid mo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: Sana tularan mo akong 32 years younger at makahanap ng pagmamahal ulit.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: I'd really just like to wish you well because you have been doing well with the Department of Social Welfare and Development.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: In fact, I see the Regional Director here, Director Lucy Alan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: Please, can you please stand up?

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: Kawani sa gobyerno doon dahil ito po talaga nakikita namin ang pagtrabaho niya sa buong regyon ay kagalang-galang at napakagaling.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: At maraming salamat sa inyong serbisyo, Director Lucy, at sana po magkaroon pa ng mas madaming kagaya po niya dahil talaga truly deserving po siya.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: Sa inyo po, open invitation po ang probinsya ng Isabela at Region 2 dahil alam ko po kung gano'ng kamahal ng kababayan ko ang inyong serbisyo, lalo na yung mga IECs na binibigyan nyo, lalong-lalo na ngayon at may mga baha at mga problema sa atin po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: So full support po ako, bagamat gusto ko na ho i-terminate ito para makauwi kayo at magkaroon kayo ng trabaho. Karagdagan,

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: Hihintayin po natin si Chairwoman Mika Suansing para i-close po ito. At rest assured, Secretary, kung pwede pong dagdagan pa yung pondo sa inyo, nang sa ganoon makatulong pa po sa lahat ng nangangailangang Pilipino, welcome po, sabihin nyo lang po at ipaglalaban ko po ang budget ng DSWD under the leadership of Secretary Rex Gatchalian po.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Thank you, Chair. Thank you, Congressman Tonypet. Maraming salamat.

segments.speaker: Rep. Antonio "Tonypet" T. Albano
segments.text: At open invitation po sa Isabela kung makakapunta po kayo, hindi sa kasal ko talaga, tapos na yung kasal. Kung meron po kayong panahon, gusto namin po kayong imbitahin para makita nyo naman po kung ano lahat yung mga natulungan yung mga kaprominsyan mo namin sa Region 2. Maraming salamat po, Secretary Rex.

segments.speaker: Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: Sek, kung anong to, isang tanong lang. Yung tertiary education subsidy went through your portal, diba? That's about 400,000 students, scholars.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: Pero you submit to them a list. You submit them a list. Kasi maliit lang yung, hindi namin na-increase yung katilang allowance, no?

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: Naging 30,000. So, it's like 15,000 per semester. As against before, 30,000 per semester.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: Ngayon, since it went through the portal naman, kayo nagbibigay nung name. In fact, marami rin nag-question na, like in my district, no?

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: City of Coronadal is the regional center. We have no state college.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: At nag-a-avail ng UniFAST TES. Kasi lahat ng private school nasa City of Koronadal.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: And all, ngayon, ang bagong policy, kailangan na kukunin yung mga new beneficiaries sa portal ng DSWD.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Mr. Chair, yung portal nasa CHED, what we do is...

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: Pero yung listahan, galing sa DSWD.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Since time immemorial po, even before this new TES law, nagsasubmit kami ng list sa kanila.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Ng mga 4Ps na eligible na dahil pagkukulehyo na po.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: Na talagang galing lang sa listahan ninyo.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: So, dahil hindi naman na-increase yung subsidy, ay yung allowance, is it possible na kung sino man yung mga nasa listahan, pwedeng maka-avail ng student assistance?

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Theoretically, Mr. Chair, yun ho sa pagkakaunawa namin yung essence ng bagong amendment.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: So, yung eligibility requirement, yung sa TES lang ho, hindi yun sa amin.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: So, meaning, lahat ng eligible, ipapadala namin sa kanila.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Then, we'll tell our parents na punta na kayo sa State U, make sure mag-comply po kayo doon sa eligibility requirements nila.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: Hindi, walang problema doon. Pero what I'm saying, kung pasok na sila doon, gusto naming dagdagan, can we go through DSWD?

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: Kasi that's the only way na madagdagan yung...

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: Importante yun kasi at least kahit papano, we can find a way na madagdagan kahit konti yung kanilang subsidy.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Mr. Chair, nasa menu pa rin naman ng AICS yan, so pwede po.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
segments.text: Okay. Yun lang, importante yun kasi at least alam ko, pwede ko na silang, pag nalista na sila, pwede pa ako magdagdag sa kanila.

segments.speaker: Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand L. Hernandez
Rep. JC Rahman A. Nava, M.D.
segments.text: Thank you, SDS. We recognize kong Mila Magsaysay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Chair. We did everything po na makreate itong NCSC, National Commission on Senior Citizens,

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: para po meron na talagang sariling komisyon ang mga senior citizens para maalagaan naman po sila ng mabuti.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Kasi ito na lang po, komisyon na ito, ang focus niya ay senior citizen.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: So ngayon po, nagkukulang talaga ang budget nila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Kasi unang-una na sila, kasi hindi nabibigay agad-agad yung centenary yan, yung 80-85-90-95.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: E ang ano naman po nito ay talaga naman pong underman sila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: So kung pwede po, ay humihingi sila ng additional na magkaroon ng job order.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Maski man lang po, two per province.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Para po, kasi we have only regional offices now, 18.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Kung ilan lang po yung manpower nila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: So ngayon, they're asking for additional job orders.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Maski two per province man lang.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Para efficiently, maano nila yung programs and projects na nasa sa kanila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: At saka itong ATOP, nung nandun sa DSWD, ay 7.5 million ang budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Kasi noon, ano lang, FESCAP lang ang organization.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Ngayon, marami na pong senior citizens organization.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: So kailangan naman po, mas malaki pa po ang ibigay na budget para makatulong po sila sa mga organizations.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Sa naman po, aabot ito sa dami ng mga senior citizens.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: So ito pa po, ano na po ito, batas na po itong digitalization.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Kasi nag-gagather po sila ng data and information ng mga senior citizens.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: So they were asking for 48 million para ma-digitalization ang NCSC.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Pero zero po ang ibinigay sa kanila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: E batas na po ito na lahat po ng government agencies, government offices should be digitalized para maging digital po sila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: So ito naman po, zero pong binigay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Baka naman po pwede na po nating ibigay ito para lalo pong makagather po sila ng information

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: tungkol sa mga senior citizens para mas madali po ang pagbibigay ng mga benefits and privileges ng mga seniors.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Kailangan-kailangan po ng mga senior citizens ang livelihood.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Kasi para po ang mga senior citizens, hindi na po umaasa sa ayuda na pumipila po sila dyan para lang sa 2,000 na mukha silang kawawa at nawawala ng dignidad ang mga senior citizens.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: So kung pwede po, dagdagan naman po ang livelihood para mabigyan nila ng livelihood ang mga senior citizens para magiging makatayo po sila sa sarili.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Hindi po sila umaasa ng mga ayuda.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Saan naman po dadating yung 4 million sa livelihood ng 12 million senior citizens?

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: At ito pa po, isa pa po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Yung mga nagbibigay ng mga benefits,

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: daladala po nila yung pera, nagtatricycle po sila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Kasi wala pong service ang mga regional offices.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: So kung pwede po, mabigyan po sila, mas kisa lang pong service kada region para naman po may sasakyan yung mga magbibigay ng mga benefits ng mga senior citizens.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: So they were asking for a capital outlay of 111,300,000.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Paano po magiging efficient ang NCSC sa pagbibigay ng mga benefits kung wala man lang po silang sasakyan para magbigay ng mga beneficyo na ito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: At wala po silang security guard.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Eh naghahawak po sila ng mga millions.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: So yan po, itong capital outlay, dito po pupunta sa vehicle per province.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Itong vehicle, at saka yung gasolina po, at saka security guard.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Ngayon po, all in all, ang Negros Island region po, wala pong budget.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Eh kailangan din po ng region na yan ng budget nila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Ang naibigay lang po is 314 million.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Siguro naman po, napakaliit po yan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Na hinihingi, nakaragdagan, para they can efficiently implement projects and programs

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: and give benefits to the senior citizens faster and on time.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: That's all for the budget of NCSC.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Mr. Chair, if I may answer, even if I'm not from NCSC, kasi nandito ho yung representative ng DBM,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: I'm quite familiar with the issue.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Tulad nung nabanggit ko kanina, we need to project kasi properly yung catchment natin o yung physical targets natin.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Ang main mandate naman ho ng NCSC at this point in time will be the expanded centenarian.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: So what's happening from my understanding, kaya ho, minsan kulang yung na-appropriate together with the admin costs.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Kasi pag may admin costs naman yan, makakapag-hire sila ng COS nila.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: DBM can also provide the other support services.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Eh, yung physical targets kasi pabaliktad, post, mag-a-apply ka muna, susuriin, tsaka natin hihingiin yung pera.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Kaya give or take may shortfall.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: We've already coordinated with NCSC at we're encouraging them to sign a data sharing agreement with PSA

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: para makuha nila yung CBMS kasi napoproject po yun.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: The 80, 85, 90, 95, and 100, napoproject yun three years in advance.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Kasi I would assume, I would like to think the good congressman believes na huwag na natin antayin silang lumapit kundi tayo ang lumapit.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: So if they have a three-year rolling plan as we recommended, na alam na nila yung kanila mga physical targets,

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: I'm sure Secretary Kim and the DBM family will grant them the necessary subsidies.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Together, nakap-embed na doon yung administrative costs for them to be able to hire more contract of service if that's what they need.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Kasi siyempre kung malaki yung subsidy mo, may kaakibat po yan na MOE or admin costs.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: I think at more than 5%, ang admin costs at more than 5%.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: So ang punto ko doon, I think we have to look at it from a paradigm na huwag sila nag-a-apply kundi tayo ang gumawa ng three-year rolling plan

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: para naka-forecast na actuarial style ilan ang magiging 80, 85, 90, 95 way, way in advance.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Itong digitalization, kailangan-kailangan po ito para makakuha sila ng mga datas at information sa mga senior citizen na mag-80, 85, 90, 95.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: E zero po ang budget nila dito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: At saka yun nga po, yung additional, kailangan talaga kasi kokonti po ang empleyado ng NCSC.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: So paano naman sila makapag-implement ng mga projects efficiently?

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Kung kokonti naman sa region, 17 regions, regional ang opisina, kokonti pa yung empleyado, paano sila maka-implement?

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: So yan po, humihingi ng additional budget kasi 314 lang yung na-release, e what is 184 million naman na maidagdag sa NCSC para naman po maka-implement sila ng projects efficiently.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Ma'am, Mr. Chair, it would be a disservice kasi nandito yung DBM representative.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: I think kasi bird's eye view, nandun ho ako from the start till now.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: So it would be a disservice for me not to advocate kung ano ho yung mga nangyaring usapan ho noon at lalong-lalo na wala dito si Secretary Kim.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Let me be the one to explain.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Ma'am, hindi ho kailangan ng data because the CBMS has the data already.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Yun ho ang ginagamit namin sa 4Ps.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Yun ang ginagamit namin sa social data.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Yun ang ginagamit namin sa pension.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Yun ang ginagamit namin sa lahat ng programa.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: All we have to do is get the list.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Then, pagdating ho sa usapin ng contract of service, hindi na ho natin kailan humingi pa ng karagdagan kasi kung lumaki yung subsidies nila o yung MOE nila na naaayon sa kanilang physical targets, may kaakibat na not more than 5% na administrative cost yun.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: So that gives them the leg room to be able to hire more contractors.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: And be able to spend on supplies and all that na para magampanan yung paglapit sa kanilang mga 80, 85, 90, 95 at 100.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: We can really project that ahead of time as far off as 3 years from now.

segments.speaker: NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
segments.text: What we're using is data from PSA PhilSys, which is complete.

segments.speaker: NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
segments.text: Unlike CBMS, there are LGUs that are not included yet in the CBMS because our LGUs who cannot pay for the cost of CBMS cannot be included.

segments.speaker: NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
segments.text: So yun po ang ginagamit namin, PhilSys.

segments.speaker: NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
segments.text: We can do that and we are in talks with PSA PhilSys para they can provide us the data that we need.

segments.speaker: NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
segments.text: When we met them, they wanted a court order for them to be able to share their data to the NCSC.

segments.speaker: NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
segments.text: And so, in our meetings with DICT, who is already developing an app for the applications of our senior citizens,

segments.speaker: NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
segments.text: they have advised us to write the Office of the President so that the PhilSys PSA can actually share their data.

segments.speaker: NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
segments.text: To the NCSC so that we can actually project the true number of senior citizens who will be benefiting from the cash gift of the ECA program.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Pero kailangan ma-digitalize kayo ang office ninyo, no?

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Para it will be more efficient na makagather din kayo ng talaga information.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: So, kailangan din ninyo talaga na ma-upgrade.

segments.speaker: NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
segments.text: Kasi we cannot capture all the data that we need about our senior citizens without, you know, a system that can actually capture these data.

segments.speaker: NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
segments.text: Ang ginagamit po namin ngayon na senior citizens online registration is what?

segments.speaker: NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
segments.text: Sapagkat wala nga po kaming pondo para pondohan yung system na kailangan namin.

segments.speaker: NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
segments.text: So, for us to be able to be a reliant agency where all the data needed about senior citizens can be derived from, we need that system po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: At saka ito nga, itong request nyo for vehicles in every region, alam mo na witness ko mismo yan sa Region 1.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Kasi daga doon ako, na nag-pay-pay out sila, may daladala silang pera, naka-tricycle sila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: So, hindi bali doon, pinapahiram ko yung service namin doon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Pero how about the other regions?

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: So, talagang it is very necessary na meron nga kayong, merong service in every region, mas kisaman lang.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: At saka security guard para meron silang kasama pag sila'y nagbabayad ng mga benefits.

segments.speaker: NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
segments.text: Yes po, 111 milyon para po sa transportation costs and the...

segments.speaker: NCSC Acting Executive Director Ana Marie C. Calapit
segments.text: 20, above 20 million for security services po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: So, Mr. Chair, Mr. Chair, yes, ay Madam Chair, andito pala si Mika.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Madam Chair, 184 million lang naman ang hinihiling nila na additional para naman po,

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: para naman maka, maano nga, efficiently they can implement the programs and projects under the NCSC.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: No, it's napakaliit naman po yun, para, just to give justice to the 12 million senior citizens, no?

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: At isa pa pong concern, kasi at saka Negros Island, wala silang, zero, zero ang budget nila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: So, madagdagan man lang ng 184, 84,000, 84 million.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Para, para mabigyan din ng budget ang ano.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Sa kaisa pa, itong LGBTQ office, no, zero po ang, ang budget nila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Bakit naman, parang discrimination naman sa mga LGBTQ na marami naman pong mga senior citizens.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
segments.text: Ellen has already answered that, but I think she can clarify again.

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Ellen Pasion
segments.text: Actually, I just want to express our, we are grateful po sa our secretary po of the SWD,

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Ellen Pasion
segments.text: kasi sila po yung nag-house sa amin and even provided po our MOOE and also the administrative support po,

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Ellen Pasion
segments.text: as stated po ng Executive Order 51.

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Ellen Pasion
segments.text: So, yeah, kaya po ma'am, mawala rin po kaming budget because of the timing of my appointment,

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Ellen Pasion
segments.text: which is September 29 of last year.

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Ellen Pasion
segments.text: So, when the budget, first budget hearing,

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Ellen Pasion
segments.text: po, was conducted, hindi po kaya kasi I was by myself,

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Ellen Pasion
segments.text: limited po yung staff ko, so hindi po kami nakapag-participate.

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Ellen Pasion
segments.text: It entails a lot of work po and documentations po, so hindi po kami nakaabot.

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Ellen Pasion
segments.text: And also, nung nag-propose na po kami for the another hearing, a budget hearing,

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Ellen Pasion
segments.text: hindi naman po pinayagan ng DBM.

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Ellen Pasion
segments.text: That's why I'm pleading po na sana po mapagbigyan po kami para po naman,

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Ellen Pasion
segments.text: magawa namin yung mandate ng EO 51, which is signed non-other by our President Marcos po.

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Ellen Pasion
segments.text: So, yeah, we want to work na sana according to our mandate.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: So, magkakaroon na kayo ng budget?

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Ellen Pasion
segments.text: Yun po yung piniplid po namin, nakikiusap po sana kami na sana po mapagbigyan po kami

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Ellen Pasion
segments.text: so we can function po, our office can really function based po sa mandate, which is policymaking po.

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Ellen Pasion
segments.text: And maliit lang po yung budget na iniling namin, which is 35 million for 2027,

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Ellen Pasion
segments.text: and that is in national scope po yan.

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Ellen Pasion
segments.text: And meron na rin po kaming plan for 2027 on how to use the budget or utilize the budget appropriately po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Sana po we will consider the budget of the LGBTQ.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Kasi kailangan din naman maasikaso rin sila eh.

segments.speaker: Rep. Milagros "Mila" Aquino-Magsaysay
segments.text: Thank you very much, Madam Chair. That's all. Thank you.

segments.speaker: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian
